normalization: Unicode NFKC + surrounding/internal whitespace normalization + Unicode casefold for lookup; accepted display text preserves the profile canonical spelling

vocabularies.unknown_rule: unknown nonblank status is warning-only evidence and cannot replace a previously recognized current status or acquire terminal/eligibility authority
vocabularies.blank_rule: blank status never clears recognized current status
vocabularies.progression_rule: recognized terminal entry is high-risk; terminal-to-nonterminal or terminal-kind correction is history-preserving reviewed correction; ordinary acceptance never silently regresses status

vocabularies.unlisted_nonblank_rule: preserve as warning-bearing source evidence with class 'unrecognized_nonterminal'; it cannot by status text alone prove execution, outcome, cancellation, terminality or RFC eligibility; other validated WFM facts may still be staged
vocabularies.blank_rule: blank status is unknown and cannot erase recognized prior provider status

cross_field_rules: WFM Dispatch Progress blank is permitted without a missing-field warning when accepted Task Status is Plan Cancel; otherwise blank remains an explicit coverage/value finding according to the profile
RFC Status from WFM is provisional fallback evidence only and is classified using RFC_STATUS_V1, but accepted Enhanced RFC status has precedence and cannot be overwritten by WFM evidence
an unrecognized controlled value is never normalized into the nearest known value
evolution: Adding/renaming/reclassifying a controlled value creates a new vocabulary ID/version. Historical source observations retain the vocabulary version used and are never reinterpreted silently.
